verdict: A regular beef burger is easier to control. Same calories, but higher protein and you usually stop at 1.
why: Calories are the same: about 300 kcal for 1 slice of pizza and 1 burger.
The burger has 15 g of protein, pizza 12 g. More protein, longer fullness.
The burger is lower in fat: 12 g vs 14 g.
Pizza is very easy to overeat. Rarely does anyone eat just 1 slice. 3 slices is already about 900 kcal.
when_a: Pizza is okay when eating in a group or celebrating a birthday. Take 1-2 slices, add salad, and enjoy it slowly.
when_b: A beef burger is okay when you want a quick meal. Choose regular size, not double, and swap the sweet drink for plain water.
tip: If you eat pizza, eat salad or vegetables first. If it's a burger, skip the large fries or share them with a friend.

faq.q: What if I still want pizza?
faq.a: You can. Decide from the start, for example 2 slices. Put them on a plate, don't eat straight from the box. Choose chicken or vegetable toppings when you can.

faq.q: Is a burger meal set okay?
faq.a: A set with fries and a sweet drink can add hundreds of calories. Take just the burger or switch to plain water. It's a small step but it makes a difference.
